bullets.title: SocialRank
bullets.note:
This cool tool was recommended to me by a number of people on Twitter for
exporting my followers and looking at analytics, sorting by “most followed,”
etc. For getting a deeper look at my tribe on
[Twitter](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanhq7q0w/q1opyg/aHR0cDovL3R3aXR0ZXIuY29tL3RmZXJyaXNz)
and [my friends on
Instagram](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanhq7q0w/x1zvjk/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS90aW1mZXJyaXNzLw==),
it’s the most elegant service that I’ve found.**

bullets.title: Race Happy
bullets.note:
This is a great piece on competing vs. happiness by 4x world champion Amelia
Boone
([@ameliaboone](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanhq7q0w/41xkjn/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9hbWVsaWFib29uZQ==)).
Many people, including me, feel a constant tension between striving to achieve
and appreciating what they have. This can also manifest as doing what you
“should” versus doing what you love. “Race Happy” delves into all of this. If
you want more, listen to Amelia’s appearance on the podcast
[here](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanhq7q0w/ly60ym/aHR0cDovL3RpbS5ibG9nLzIwMTUvMTIvMjIvYW1lbGlhLWJvb25lLw==).
